in_hebrew.name: מתיס
in_hebrew.meaning: מתן אלוהים, מתיס הוא מתנת אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מתיס הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'מתנת אלוהים' או 'מתן אלוהים'. השם מתיס הוא גרסה עברית של השם היווני 'Μαθθαῖος' (מתוס), שפירושו גם הוא 'מתנת אלוהים'. השם מתיס מופיע בתנ"ך כמתיס, אחד מתלמידי ישו, ששמו היה במקור לוי.

in_greek.name: Μαθίς
in_greek.long_meaning: Μαθίς είναι ἕνα ὄνομα ἑβραϊκόν, ποὺ σημαίνει 'δωρεὰ θεοῦ' ἤ 'δώρο του Θεοῦ'. Τὸ ὄνομα Μαθίς εἶναι ἕνα ἀπὸ τὰ οὐσιαστικά τοῦ ονόματος Ματθαῖος, ποὺ ἦταν ὀνομασμένος ὁ Μαθητής τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ποὺ ἦταν πρὶν Λευὶ.

in_latin.name: Mathis
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Mathis est variatio nominis hebraici 'מתיס' (Mathis), quod significat 'donum Dei' seu 'dono de Dios'. Nomen Mathis inveniuntur in traditione christiana, et est forma latina nominis Ματθαῖος (Matthaeus), unius discipulorum Iesu Christi.

in_english.name: Mathis
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mathis is of Hebrew origin, meaning 'gift of God' or 'divine gift'. Derived from the Hebrew name 'מתיס' (Mattithyahu), it is related to the Greek name 'Ματθαῖος' (Matthaeus), one of Jesus' twelve apostles. Historically, the name Mathis has been used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing a spiritual gift or blessing from God.

biblical_reference.note: Mathis or Matthaeus was one of Jesus' twelve apostles, previously named Levi.

saint_reference.note: Saint Matthew was an apostle and evangelist, author of the Gospel of Matthew.

data.cultural_impact: The name Matthias has been popular in Christian communities due to its Biblical origins. It was a name that held significance as one of the twelve apostles chosen by God to continue the spreading of the gospel and the building of the early Christian community.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual sense, the name Matthias carries the reminder that each one of us is a gift from God, whether we carry the name Matthias or any other name. It serves as a constant reminder to live our lives with purpose and to use the unique gifts and talents that God has given us to serve and make an impact in the world around us.

historical_references.reference: Mathis the Elder, also known as Matthias Corvinus or Matthias Rex, was a king of Hungary, ruling from 1458 to 1490.
historical_references.context: Mathis was a learned ruler who patronized the arts and sciences. He was known for his extensive library, which eventually became the foundation of the Hungarian National Library.

historical_references.reference: Matthias of Janowice, also known as Matthias of Janowice the Elder, was a Polish nobleman and voivode of Silesia, ruling from around 1455 to 1467.
historical_references.context: Matthias played a significant role in the political events of the region, including attempts to gain control of Silesia and other territories. He was also known for his military prowess and diplomatic skills.
